changelog:
x-twitter-post-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of AI-powered generator for X (Twitter) posts and slides.
- Create editable posts with AI-generated captions, images, text, and backgrounds.
- Supports multiple formats: Knowledge Cards, Posters, Movie Introductions, and more.
- Designs follow structured visual style rules and are export-ready for X.
- Built-in support for prompt-based generation with customizable size, style, and layout options.
summary: AI X Twitter Post Generator — Generate editable, X (Twitter) - ready posts and slides with AI-created content, captions, images, text blocks, storylines, and backgrounds. Supports Knowledge Cards, Posters, Movie Introductions, and more, with designs automatically structured according to visual style
